hooks.command:
ruff_out=$(python3 -m ruff check . 2>&1); ruff_exit=$?; black_out=$(python3 -m black --check . 2>&1); black_exit=$?; if [ "$ruff_exit" -ne 0 ] || [ "$black_exit" -ne 0 ]; then jq -n --arg r "$ruff_out" --arg b "$black_out" '{"decision":"block","reason":("Fix before finishing:
ruff:
"+$r+"
black:
"+$b)}'; fi
